title: Typical dictionaries, exact marks and compound Poisson clusters
summary: Poisson comparisons for word dictionaries, including mean distances for uniformly sampled fixed-size and affine dictionaries with each dictionary held fixed inside the comparison. Exact excesses and signs, category aggregation, geometric marks and compound Poisson cluster laws are retained.
